decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool2' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0407. Series context: trend strength 0.9755 and seasonal strength 0.1132; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.251); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.328.
